message:
feat: prepare 0.6.0 with HDL simulation, inspection and exports

Add HDL highlighting, WaveDrom register/logic families, Yosys netlist schematics and the local VCD viewer.

Integrate authorized application-owned HDL executors, browser HTTP transport and optional native GHDL, Icarus/VVP and Yosys backends. Add interactive replay, shared session scheduling, bounded incremental results, scripted stimuli and four-state checks.

Add signal inspection, dual cursors, exact decimal values and local VCD/CSV/SVG/JSON/TXT exports with host callbacks. Preserve cancellation, cleanup, sizing and existing backend compatibility.

Document the contracts in English and provide 105 matching lessons per language (315 total) across all 24 extensions.

Validate 576 engine tests, 51 backend tests, 21 production distribution tests, five application configuration tests, lint, types, build and package contents. Advance package and lockfile versions to 0.6.0.
